text:
Aisha: Quick weekly health snapshot for Summer cohort — token usage + throughput (WoW / QoQ). TL;DR: overall growth but two flags: one account downturn, one transient error spike.

Aisha: High level
- Week tokens: 18.2M (WoW +12%, QoQ +38%) :chart_with_upwards_trend:
- Avg throughput: 5.6k tokens/sec; peak 7.8k sustained (30m)
- P95 generation latency: 110ms (improved from 125ms)
- Error rate (500s + timeouts): 0.9% (was 0.45% last week) :warning:
- Hosted spend this week: $8.2k; projected monthly ~ $32k

Aisha: Account callouts
- Halcyon: tokens -28% WoW; reserved utilization 42%; renewal in ~45 days — potential churn risk.
- NovaPay: healthy ramp, two users ~120k tokens/day each. Recommend temporary burst increase on Dedicated.
- Meridian Labs: brief 3x spike in 5xxs during Thu 12:10–12:25 UTC, coincident with a model/config rollout.

Aisha: Ask list
1) @Luca schedule Halcyon renewal + 30m enablement (prompt tuning & batching best practices)
2) @Ravi pull Meridian logs for 12:05–12:30 UTC and verify rollout metadata
3) @María produce 7-day rolling tokens per account + QoQ cohort chart by EOD
4) Ops evaluate rate-limit bump for NovaPay tomorrow morning

María: Quick extracts from query (2m ago)
- Query used: SELECT account, SUM(tokens) week_tokens, AVG(tokens_per_sec) avg_throughput FROM usage WHERE week = '2026-03-09' GROUP BY account;
- Halcyon: 112k tokens this week (155k prior); avg throughput 320 t/s
- NovaPay: 840k tokens this week; avg throughput 1.2k t/s
- Meridian Labs: backend 503s concentrated 12:12–12:18 UTC; 86 events logged

Luca: On Halcyon — scheduling Thu 09:00 PT tentative. Will propose: prefix caching, conservative batching, and a quantized model variant to cut unit cost.

Ravi: Quick triage: deploy swapped to v1.4-quant with a bad kernel-selector build; rollback at 12:20 cleared errors. I'll paste the logs and open an incident if repeats occur.

MetricsBot: alert: "500-rate" breach for cluster redwood-ml-03 at 2026-03-18T12:12:05Z — peak 1.1% for ~8min.

Aisha: Plan
- Ravi: incident write-up if this repeats >2 times
- María: deck slide with QoQ drivers for Monday exec sync
- Luca: run enablement + suggest renewal concession (3 months burst credit?)

FinanceOps: happy to consider a 3-month burst credit; need projected delta. @Aisha can you send spend projection if Halcyon is moved to 70% utilization?

Aisha: Projection quick calc — moving Halcyon to 70% util -> ~185k tokens/week -> incremental hosted spend ~$420/week. Dedicated reserved would lower unit cost; sending detailed calc via DM.

María: Uploaded charts to drive: /drive/cs/weeklies/summer_cohort_qoq_wow.png

Aisha: Thanks — next steps: Luca books Halcyon call, María finalizes slides by EOD, Ravi posts a short incident summary. Re-run this recap next Wed same time. :white_check_mark:
